modulePlaceholder.heading: {module}
modulePlaceholder.body: This module is scheduled for a later prompt. The shell around it — navigation, locale, theme, session — is what is live today.
modulePlaceholder.scopeNote: Every query this module will make is scoped to your organization before it reaches the database.

dashboard.title: Workspace
dashboard.subtitle: Signed in. Modules arrive in later prompts; the session below is what every scoped query will carry.

masterData.deleteBody: It stops appearing in lists straight away. Nothing is erased — records that point at it keep working, and an administrator can restore it.
masterData.readOnly: You have read access. Creating and editing is done by an administrator or FM manager.
masterData.resultCount: {total, plural, =0 {No records} one {1 record} other {# records}}

clients.title: Clients
clients.subtitle: The customers whose buildings you maintain. Contracts, invoices and client logins all attach here.
clients.emptyBody: Add the first customer to start attaching sites, contracts and invoices to it.
clients.name: Name
clients.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It appears on contracts and invoices, and is fixed once saved.

locations.title: Locations
locations.subtitle: Every site you maintain. Assets and work orders are dispatched to these.
locations.clientSubtitle: The sites maintained for your account.
locations.emptyBody: Add a site to start attaching assets and work orders to it.
locations.clientEmptyBody: Sites your provider adds for your account will appear here.
locations.name: Name
locations.clientHint: Fixed once saved. A site cannot be moved between clients.

organization.title: Organization
organization.subtitle: Your tenant's profile. It appears on invoices and sets the defaults every module inherits.
organization.name: Organization name
organization.slugHint: Fixed. It keys sign-in links, so it cannot be changed here.
organization.vatNumberHint: 15 digits, as issued by ZATCA. Leave empty if registration is not complete.
organization.missing: This organization could not be loaded.

portal.scopeNote: You see this record and these sites only. Every query the app makes on your behalf is narrowed to your account before it reaches the database.

assets.title: Assets
assets.subtitle: The plant and equipment you maintain. Work orders, PPM schedules and contracts all attach to these.
assets.clientSubtitle: The equipment maintained at your sites.
assets.emptyBody: Add the first piece of equipment to start scheduling maintenance against it.
assets.clientEmptyBody: Equipment your provider registers at your sites will appear here.
assets.name: Name
assets.typeHint: The model or kind within the category — Chiller, AHU, Fire panel.
assets.locationHint: An asset can only move between sites belonging to the same client.
assets.healthHint: Condition from 0 to 100. Set by hand until work-order history can derive it.

technicians.title: Technicians
technicians.subtitle: The people who do the work. Trades and skills here are what dispatch matches a work order against.
technicians.emptyBody: Add the first technician to start assigning preventive and corrective work.
technicians.noMatchesBody: Nobody in the directory matches these filters. Clear them to see everyone.
technicians.name: Name
technicians.skillsPlaceholder: Add a skill, then press Enter
technicians.accountNoneLong: This technician has no sign-in account. They are dispatched through a supervisor.
technicians.accountHint: Only active technician accounts in your organization can be linked, and each account belongs to one technician.
technicians.deleteBody: They stop appearing in the directory and in dispatch straight away. Nothing is erased — completed work orders keep naming them, and an administrator can restore the record.

preventive.title: Preventive maintenance
preventive.subtitle: The planned visits your team works from — what is due, who is doing it, and what has slipped.
preventive.emptyBody: Planned maintenance visits appear here. Schedule one against an asset to start building the calendar.
preventive.dueDateHint: The day the visit is due, not a time.
preventive.deleteBody: The visit is removed from the schedule. Its record is kept for audit.

corrective.title: Corrective maintenance
corrective.subtitle: The faults your team is reacting to — what is broken, how badly, and who has it.
corrective.clientSubtitle: Faults raised at your sites — what you have reported, and where each one has got to.
corrective.emptyBody: Reactive work orders appear here. Raise one against an asset when something fails.
corrective.clientEmptyBody: You have not reported any faults. Raise one against your equipment and the team will pick it up.
corrective.issueHint: What is wrong, in enough detail for whoever picks it up.
corrective.technicianHint: Who is going to do it. Only active technicians are listed.
corrective.unassignToast: Work order returned to the queue.
corrective.deleteBody: The work order is removed from the queue. Its record is kept for audit.
